statements.status_notes: Atlantis returns its running version from the /status endpoint. The advisory lists affected versions up to 0.35.1 and names no patched release. Version 0.48.1, which this image ships, still returns its version there, so the image is exposed and there is no release to upgrade to. The exposure is limited to version disclosure and does not affect integrity or availability. This statement will be revised when upstream ships a fix.
